visual.general_description: Nine-panel (A to I) figure of angiographic images: a 3D vessel reconstruction, intraoperative fluoroscopic frames, a mesh device image, subtracted lateral-appearing angiograms with and without arrows, and post-procedure angiography.
visual.detailed_description: Three rows of three grayscale angiographic tiles, lettered A to I at the lower left of each tile. Row 1: a black-background 3D reconstruction (A) and two fluoroscopic-style frames with a wire and mesh outline (B) and a large dark rounded structure with a wire (C). Row 2: a braided mesh device image (D) and two subtracted angiograms with dark enlarged tortuous channels (E, F), F carrying one star-shaped mark, one arrowhead and three arrows (thin straight, curved, double-headed). Row 3: two pale gray frames with yellow burned-in institution text at the upper right (G, H) and an angiogram with yellow institution text at the upper right and red burned-in device text at the lower left (I).

panels.general_description: Black-background three-dimensional rendered angiographic reconstruction of a vascular segment.
panels.detailed_description: Grayscale volume-rendered vessel tree on a black field. A long vessel ascends from the bottom edge with a looped bend near its lower end and another winding bend in the lower middle. Near the upper middle-left, one or two rounded bulges lie along the vessel at the level of a curve; a dense cluster of fine branching vessels fans out at the upper right. The panel letter A is at the lower left and a small image-counter style text with a slash is at the very bottom left edge. The count and exact outline of the bulges cannot be separately resolved at this size; the caption states two aneurysms.
